messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER — Alert: dedicated-router:d-42 telemetry drop + queued requests rising. 90s spike, error-rate 12% for dedicated pools in us-west-2. Paging oncall rotation: Priya. https://internal.metrics/r/alerts/9832
Priya (oncall): acked. I'm looking. can someone confirm customer impact? any 5xx spikes from frontend?
Jane (cs): seeing multiple tickets from acme-corp and shoply -> users hit timeouts around 18:12Z, they reported 503s and long tails. Marking impact P1 until mitigated.
Priya (oncall): quick summary from metrics: router.health.eligible_hosts[d-42] dropped to 0, autoscaler reports pool "ready" and nodes show healthy at infra-level. looks like router is misreading the capacity signal. requests get routed to pool -> blackhole (no backpressure) -> 503 at edge.
Luis (router): pulling router logs now. Suspect the telemetry emitter has started to emit ephemeral meta:available_count=0 for 2s windows due to a new health-check change. grabbing logs...
Priya (oncall): good. if it's a telemetry misreport, fallback policy might be kicking in causing oscillation. we need a mitigation plan: 1) stop fallback loop, 2) prevent more traffic blackholing, 3) scale and drain affected pool if needed, 4) patch emitter.
Marta (sre): agree. propose immediate steps: - flip router fallback_policy to prefer regional-hosted for failing requests (temporary bypass) - disable automatic downward scaling until telemetry patch - set pool d-42 to manual scale + drain flag
Priya (oncall): doing step 1: setting router.fallback_policy.override=hosted-prefer temporarily (applied). Ops-Bot: confirm change?
Ops-Bot: router policy override applied by Priya at 2026-03-15T18:15:02Z. Old policy backed up to s3://configs/routers/d-42/backup-1832100456.json :ok_hand:
Priya (oncall): step 2: attempting manual scale to avoid autoscaler decisions. running: `rctl pool scale dedicated-42 --replicas 6 --force`
Priya (oncall): command output:
```
Request accepted. Pool dedicated-42 scaling to 6 replicas (manual override)
Previous: replica_count=2
Autoscaler suspended for pool dedicated-42
```
Luis (router): router logs snippet where telemetry flips to zero repeatedly:
```
2026-03-15T18:12:37Z router[pid=2231] INFO telemetry_emit host=d-42 meta.available_count=0
2026-03-15T18:12:39Z router[pid=2231] INFO telemetry_emit host=d-42 meta.available_count=3
2026-03-15T18:12:40Z router[pid=2231] INFO telemetry_emit host=d-42 meta.available_count=0
```
Luis (router): that 2s blip pattern makes the router de-register the pool for a few cycles and then re-register -> oscillation and dropped in-flight requests. looks like a regression in the health-check debounce introduced in the last deploy.
Marta (sre): can we bump the debounce window on the router to 10s as a quick mitigation? we should avoid a full restart if possible.
Priya (oncall): applying soft debounce change: `routerctl set debounce-ms --host d-42 --value 10000`
Ops-Bot: debounce-ms set to 10000 for host d-42 by Priya at 2026-03-15T18:19:11Z.
Priya (oncall): rolling monitoring: latency errors dropping within expected window. question for infra: did any infra-level health-checks actually fail or is this purely telemetry?
Marta (sre): infra node health is green, underlying GPUs show normal metrics. so it's telemetry only. good. Next: patch the telemetry emitter in canary and roll. Luis, can you take that?
Luis (router): on it. I will revert the debounce regression in the next quick patch and push a canary to us-west-2. prepping a fix PR now.
Luis (router): PR: https://git.internal/r/router/commit/3f4b8 - changed healthcheck debounce logic to ignore transient 0s under 5s. deploying canary to router-d-42-canary.
Priya (oncall): Customer impact update: Jane, can you notify the two impacted customers we mitigated a routing oscillation and we've applied a temporary bypass + manual scaling. ETA for full patch and rollback of overrides 30-45m?
Jane (cs): sending messages now. acme-corp and shoply informed. both flagged us as "degraded" but already see improvement since 18:20Z. I'll follow-up with support tickets.
Sam (oncall-next): I'll take the handoff in 25 mins. Priya, can you add a checklist for what to monitor during my shift?
Priya (oncall): checklist added in this thread: - confirm router telemetry stable (no 0 blips for 10m) - watch 5xx rate <1% for targeted customers - ensure autoscaler remains suspended on d-42 - confirm patch rollout completes canary -> region -> prod - prepare rollback to original policy after 30m stable
Marta (sre): also add: capture packet-level traces of the blackholed requests (we have traces for 18:12-18:20Z). storing to /incidents/1832100456/traces.tar.gz
Priya (oncall): marking incident as mitigated / customer impact reduced. we'll keep monitoring and Sam will own the postmortem. Sam, you'll be owner for RCA and timeline?
Sam (oncall-next): I got it. I'll open the postmortem and assign to Luis (router) + Marta (sre) for remediation. action items: fix debounce regression, add canary gating for telemetry changes, add a circuit-breaker in router to avoid blackholing when pulsing zeros occur.
Priya (oncall): handoff to Sam in 20m. leaving notes in runbook under incidents/dedicated-routing-misread. final confirmation: last 10m 5xx for acme-corp -> down from 12% to 0.8%.
Jane (cs): customers responded: acme-corp says errors stopped, will ping if they see regressions.
Luis (router): patch deployed to canary, observing telemetry now stable. planning region rollout in 10m after canary looks good.
Priya (oncall): closing pager. Sam will follow up for RCA and postmortem owner. thanks all for fast responses. :heart:
IncidentBot: incident updated to status=mitigated by Priya at 2026-03-15T18:24:01Z. acknowledgement recorded.
